verdict.rationale: Insomnia is a desktop API client and design/testing tool, not runtime gateway infrastructure. Proxying and governing production LLM/MCP traffic with token limits, prompt guards and provider routing belongs to a gateway product, so this axis is a category error for Insomnia. Its MCP features are client-side (connecting to and testing external MCP servers). The mention of connecting to Konnect to protect requests describes a separate Kong platform, not a gateway capability Insomnia itself ships.
